title: Max Levels
description: Maximum level caps for buildings, heroes, gear, governor equipment, troops and other game features in Kingshot.

entries.name: Standard Building Caps
entries.summary: Baseline maximum levels for buildings before the Age of Truegold.

entries.name: Truegold Enhanced Buildings
entries.summary: At ~70 days (Age of Truegold), certain buildings can exceed level 30. Truegold unlocks in windows as the kingdom ages: first cap is TG3, later opens to TG5, and currently the game goes up to TG8.

details.unlock: Age of Truegold (~day 70 of the kingdom)

progression_windows.note: The Truegold cap opens in stages as the kingdom gets older; each window mirrors the level-30-to-TG jump.
progression_windows.window_1: Level 30 -> TG3 (initial Age of Truegold cap)
progression_windows.window_2: TG3 -> TG5 (the tutorial stage we went through)
progression_windows.window_3: TG5 -> TG8 (current maximum; assumed same window pattern)

details.upgrade_path: From level 30 to TG1 you pass through five stages: 30-1, 30-2, 30-3, 30-4, then TG1.
details.levels_added: Each building gains 15 additional levels through the Truegold system.

entries.name: Hero & Gear Caps
entries.summary: Maximum levels for heroes and their gear.

entries.name: Governor Equipment Caps
entries.summary: Governor gear and charms — a major source of power.

details.note: Governor equipment is a huge source of power in the game.

entries.name: Other Feature Caps
entries.summary: Maximum levels for miscellaneous game features and map content.
